name: Livesheet
family: hybrid (era-media x artifact) — Glance x Werkbank cross
thesis: A drawing that knows what's happening.

pages.index.html: your live sheet — KPI dims, offer work-orders, garage, feed, week
pages.market.html: market sheet — live search, icon category chips, fitment switch, 9 listings
pages.car.html: public car sheet — motion hero with live callouts; ruled 18-entry build sheet, for-sale, live activity — quiet anchor jump-row, no tabs
pages.listing.html: part sheet — measured spec, live offer window, 2-step job-card buy sheet
pages.dashboard.html: the workbench — listings manager, job pipelines, payout ledger
pages.explore.html: survey — live car sheets, parts and fresh entries with type filters
pages.home.html: public landing — motion hero under live callouts, 3 ticking steps, sheet + parts strips, ink stat band
pages.orders.html: job card #1058 — pipeline dots, dispatch form that advances it, payout math, buyer tile, past jobs
pages.profile.html: keeper sheet — identity + measured seller grade, follow/message, cars, listings, ruled reviews, live activity
pages.garage.html: owner's desk — annotated hero, owner-mode build sheet with [ RELEASE ] lines + working prefilled modal, documents, second-sheet teaser
pages.settings.html: configuration sheet — ruled control rows, signal matrix, fees, theme select synced to bar toggle, dirty flag + sticky save

showpiece: car.html hero: Higgsfield dolly video under live leader-line callouts with ticking watch counts
themes: night — token remap, SHEET DAY/NIGHT toggle in the bar, localStorage 'ls-theme'
